name: Luna 2
short_status: Impacted the Moon in Palus Putredinis on 13 Sep 1959 at 21:02:23 UT (00:02 on 14 Sep Moscow time): the first human-made object to reach another world.
tagline: OKB-1 · Soviet Union · Impactor · 1959 · The space race Success
stats: human-made object to reach another world
altitude down to which no lunar magnetic field was found

facts.label: Launch
facts.value: 12 September 1959, 06:39:42 UT, Tyuratam (Baikonur), on an 8K72 (no. I1-7b), after a 9 September abort

facts.label: Spacecraft mass
facts.value: 390.2 kg; design and instruments similar to Luna 1, no onboard propulsion

facts.label: Sodium cloud
facts.value: 1 kg released 12 September at 18:42:42 UT, ~156,000 km from Earth; expanded to ~650 km diameter

facts.label: Impact
facts.value: 13 September 1959 at 21:02:23 UT, which was 00:02:23 on 14 September Moscow time; radio signals ceased abruptly

facts.label: Impact site
facts.value: Palus Putredinis, near Aristillus, Archimedes and Autolycus; very roughly 29.1 N, 0 E (estimates 29-31 N, 1 W to 1 E); crater never identified in orbital imagery

facts.label: Third stage
facts.value: Impacted the Moon about 30 minutes after Luna 2, at an unknown location

facts.label: Science results
facts.value: No significant lunar magnetic field measured to within 55 km of the surface; no evidence of lunar radiation belts

facts.label: Pennants
facts.value: Pentagonal CCCP emblems carried in 9 x 15 cm metal spheres, scattered on the surface at impact

facts.label: Khrushchev's gift
facts.value: A model of the pennant sphere was presented to President Eisenhower in the Oval Office on 15 September 1959; kept at the Eisenhower Presidential Library

timeline: Launch at 06:39:42 UT from Tyuratam (Baikonur) on an 8K72
18:42:42 UT: Orange sodium cloud released ~156,000 km from Earth; expanded to ~650 km across
21:02:23 UT: Radio signals cease: Luna 2 impacts Palus Putredinis, the first human-made object on another world (00:02:23 on 14 Sep Moscow time)
Around 21:32 UT: the rocket's third stage strikes the Moon at an unknown location
Khrushchev presents Eisenhower a model of the Luna 2 pennant sphere in the Oval Office
